verdicts.reason: CONFIRMED. Active path = single-page only. openWizard:4773 and refreshWizard:5136 render renderSinglePage() then call bindSinglePageEvents() (4777/5136). The add-to-cart handler in bindSinglePageEvents (pos-wizard.js:5850-5855) calls syncAndSubmit() with NO completeness gate. canProceedFromStep() (5149-5226) is invoked ONLY in bindEvents() at 5454-5467 — and bindEvents() has ZERO call sites (grep: only def at 5288; line 5493 comment 'Removed duplicate ... from bindEvents()' confirms it is legacy/dead). So the 'Selectionnez N viandes / sauce / pain' guard never runs in the active flow: a Tacos with 0 viande / sandwich with 0 pain can be added to cart. Real defect, worth correcting (the guard exists but is dead). FROZEN: describe-only + owner gate.

CONFIRMED by code alone (no DB query needed). calculateRunningTotal adds FRITES_GRANDE_PRICE + FRITES_CHEDDAR_PRICE to the preview (pos-wizard.js:1325-1326). But addonToPayload (4143-4159) sets convert_price = base addon price and pushes 'Grande Portion (+...)' / 'Cheddar Fondu (+...)' ONLY into menu_extras + instruction (TEXT). Server SSOT PricingService::calculateOrder prices addons strictly from $dbAddon->addonItem->price (PricingService.php:226) and extras strictly from $dbExt->price*qty (line 189) — it NEVER reads client convert_price/total_price/menu_extras/instruction. OrderQuoteService:209/224 routes through this. Therefore the +1.00/+1.00 surcharges are display-only and never billed → preview > billed total. Systematic silent under-billing on frites options. FROZEN: describe + owner gate.

CONFIRMED real, but the auditor's stated mechanism is partly MISDIAGNOSED. The single-page viande-supplement rows (renderSinglePage 2954-3019) are built from lastItemData.variations (viandeVariations.push(v)), keyed 'v_<variationId>' — these are ItemVariation IDs, NOT ItemExtra IDs. syncAndSubmit (3886-3897) does allSelectedExtras[parseInt(variationId)]=true then applies it to '.extra .custom-checkbox-field' (extra checkboxes, 3905-3912). Variation and extra ID spaces differ, and there is no DB item_extra for an extra viande, so the surcharge is almost never matched to a real priced extra → not just 'flat price vs catalogue / qty lost' but NOT BILLED AT ALL server-side (PricingService only prices DB extras by id+qty, 184-189). Net effect = preview shows +2.50/+5.00, server quote bills 0 for the extra viande (M3-02-class under-bill). Real preview/bill discrepancy; severity held at P2 because exact magnitude is bounded to the viande-supplement flow and the precise DB mapping warrants live confirm. FROZEN: describe with corrected mechanism + owner gate.

EXISTENCE CONFIRMED: renderWizard() (1046) has zero call sites; active render is renderSinglePage() only (4773/5135); bindEvents() (5288, containing goToNext/PrevActiveStep + canProceedFromStep wiring) has zero call sites; getActiveSteps/Index also feed only the dead path. So ~250+ lines of multi-step engine + progress bar are dead. HOWEVER necessity is LOW: pure dead code in a FROZEN file has zero runtime effect. Removing it is a frozen-zone touch with regression risk and no functional gain; the only actionable consequence (the dead guard) is already captured by M3-01. Downgraded P3 and is_necessary:false — document-only, do NOT inflate the same root cause (dead multi-step engine) twice with M3-01. Owner gate before any deletion.

CONFIRMED. fmtPrice (pos-wizard.js:218-221) returns '€' + num.toFixed(2) → '€3.00' (symbol before, dot decimal), used across all wizard preview prices. FR locale (ADR-007 immutable) convention is '3,00 €' (symbol after, comma decimal), as honored by PaymentComponent. Real, visible, permanent cosmetic inconsistency on the cashier screen. Low severity (cosmetic, no pricing/fiscal impact) → P3. FROZEN: describe-only + owner gate.

EXISTENCE CONFIRMED: isComposerAwareEnabled (436-439) reads FK_POS_WIZARD_COMPOSER_AWARE_ENABLED, default false (config/catalog_v15.php:104). buildStepsFromComposerProfile (493) is only reached from buildSteps at 553-556 when the flag is ON; renderSinglePage has no 'generic_choices' renderer branch, so composer steps would not drive the single-page UI even if flipped. Verdict: LATENT, not an active V1 bug (flag OFF). is_necessary:false for V1 — it is a documentation item / pre-cloud-flip caveat, not a correction owner must make now. P3 latent, document-only. Owner gate before any flip.

Unlike M3-02/03, extra sauces ARE mapped to REAL DB-backed Vue checkboxes 'Sauce supplementaire: <name>' in syncAndSubmit (3776-3818: extraSauceCheckedIds → allSelectedExtras → clicks '.extra .custom-checkbox-field'), so they ARE sent and server-priced from DB (PricingService:184-189). Real-but-minor preview-accuracy concern, not a confirmed billing defect → P3 needs-verify, is_necessary:false (owner/data-ops alignment check, not a code correction). Not a P2 under-bill.
